fieldValues.title: A PR carries its decisions in one srs-decisions block
fieldValues.decision_question: Where does a pull request record the decisions it makes and the decisions it asks for?
fieldValues.context: Proposed by agent:claude-code from the srs-lab control room (clerk#77). Prototyped against the live PRs on 2026-10-17: clerk#57 asked for thirteen decisions already ratified; srs-programme#154 and #155 proposed decisions only inside their diffs, in state draft; clerk#75 stated a constraining design principle in prose.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every pull request records each decision it makes or asks for in one srs-decisions block in its body, classed and naming its actor; nothing a PR decides lives only in its prose.
fieldValues.rationale: Prose asks go stale and are missed; a block can be read by the desk, the session agenda, the reviewer and the control room, and answered in place.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a decision is found in a merged PR that its block does not name, or the block is routinely left empty.
